subject: RE: ABC Manufacturing — 2026 renewal submission
text:
Hi Maya,

Attached is the 2026 renewal submission for ABC Manufacturing. A few headline changes from expiring:

  • Total insured values increased to $151.2M following the annual appraisal update.
  • The insured acquired the Tampa distribution center (Loc 47) in March 2026 — 1 story, tilt-up, fully sprinklered.
  • The roof at Reno was replaced in 2019 per the facilities team; the SOV still shows 2011, we'll correct it.
  • Business income is now $15M at the Columbus plant after the new line came online.

The insured is hoping to hold the 2% named storm deductible given their loss history. Loss runs through 06/30 are attached — no property losses above $250K in the last five years.

Let me know if you need anything else ahead of the quote.

Best,
Jordan Pike
